title: Consolidated Bottleneck Analysis
agentsConsolidated: B through I (Portfolio Throughput, Domain E, Domain F, Domain C, Review Cycle, Authoring Capacity)

topFindings.finding: DL-008 is ZERO. All 67 items were DL-029 false positives. S802 was correct.
topFindings.impact: Saves 3 sessions. Removes a phase from the critical path. Learner pool already clean.

topFindings.finding: Domain E bottleneck: 129 archived DL-012 clones (77% of gap) — each needs individual re-rotation and audit.
topFindings.impact: Cannot be batch-processed. Each item = 15-20 min of individual attention.

topFindings.finding: Domain F bottleneck: 149 greenfield items needing full authoring. Not repair — pure creation.
topFindings.impact: Content authoring capacity is the binding constraint, not file-scope or governance.

topFindings.finding: Domain C is 100% certified. 454 rewrite candidates are quality polish only — not a bottleneck.
topFindings.impact: S307 overstated Domain C urgency. Case-bank EW is the only real Domain C need.

topFindings.finding: 600-series has no net benefit. Startup cost (~3-4 sessions) equals projected savings (~3-4 sessions).
topFindings.impact: DEFER. Re-evaluate if authoring velocity proves to be the binding constraint.

topFindings.finding: Modernization deferral saves 10 sessions with acceptable quality impact.
topFindings.impact: DL-013, DL-031, EC normalization can run post-cert without affecting certification quality.

outcomes.reliability: VERIFIED — all numerical claims cross-checked against live pack parse
